info.title: scalver
info.description: Calculate scalable calendar versions from Git commit dates.

options.name: --major
options.description:
Major version number (required,
bump manually for breaking changes)

options.name: --date-format
options.description:
YYYYMM     Date format for ScalVer: YYYY,
YYYYMM, or YYYYMMDD

options.name: --folder
options.description:
Repository-relative folder whose
commits determine the version
beta, rc)

options.name: --buildmetadata
options.description:
Include build metadata (short SHA)
in the version

options.name: --output
options.description: Text       Output format: text or json
